_comment: PLACEHOLDER round-trip classifier v1 — NOT a corpus-fitted model. The labelled P/A/Q pair corpus does not exist yet; materializing it, fitting a class-balanced StandardScaler+LogisticRegression, and freezing the threshold is the productionization step gated behind the publication guard. Until then this transparent linear head over the RAW 19 features (scaler_mean=0 / scaler_scale=1) surfaces sensible scores with the reference design's signs — the detector MACHINERY ships, its accuracy does not. Do not treat these coefficients as a fitted operating point.
